zones.title: agentsop.ai
zones.summary: Router for agent standard operating procedures. It knows nothing about you: ~/.config/agent-sop/config.toml names your repositories; each zone says what to read in them.
intro: First visit, or arrived here by accident: read https://agentsop.ai/start/llms.txt.
Otherwise pick the zone for the question.
